description: This file contains tests for the 'channels' command, focusing on the runtime error reporting within status output, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: collectStatusIssues
methods.description: Collects status issues for the 'signal' plugin based on the last error reported.

methods.name: setActivePluginRegistry
methods.description: Sets the active plugin registry for testing, resetting between tests.

methods.name: createChannelTestPluginBase
methods.description: Creates a base plugin object for channel testing with a given plugin ID.

methods.name: createTestRegistry
methods.description: Creates a test plugin registry with specified plugins.

methods.name: formatGatewayChannelsStatusLines
methods.description: Formats the status lines for channels, including runtime errors, for display.
